limits: Exercises the actual wizard persistence/summary branch in an owned temporary project, substituting only the helper path and explicit fixture revision. Fixed metadata only; no model, installer, real credentials, host writes or network. BAD inputs are a nonzero exit mislabeled installed, an offered step without an observation, and an old green receipt behind a destination symlink which the real writer refuses. Each has a committed repaired GOOD case. UNKNOWN status cases distinguish absent and malformed records. Recorded state is historical evidence, not current connectivity. The always-complete anchor is constructed, not a historical pre-fix artifact.

anchors.why: Constructed substitute retains absent/malformed status detection but its writer and summary always declare complete, ignoring persistence, exit codes and offered observations. Thus only the intended outcome/consumer blindness differs on BAD inputs; known GOOD and UNKNOWN cases remain identical. No historical no-receipt helper exists to vendor.
